name: Javi López, Borja Giménez Larraz - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: INTERIM REPORT in view of the consent procedure on the Political, Economic and Cooperation Strategic Partnership Agreement between the EU and Mexico
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its position before it votes on whether to approve a new partnership agreement between the EU and Mexico. The report does not change any law itself. It asks for stronger commitments on human rights, democracy, the rule of law and fighting corruption, and it raises concerns about violence, missing persons and judicial reforms in Mexico. It also welcomes new trade openings and protections for European products.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament lists what it wants from the deal before giving consent.
- **Who it affects:** EU and Mexican companies, farmers, workers, and people affected by crime and rights abuses.
- **What happens next:** Parliament votes on consent; the trade part can then apply before full ratification.
